source_frontmatter.name: crypto-research
source_frontmatter.description: Deep-dive research report on a specific cryptocurrency before trading or investing. Always trigger immediately when the user's message starts with "cr" followed by a coin name or ticker. Also trigger on "research [coin]", "due diligence [coin]", "is [coin] worth buying", or any request for a structured breakdown of a specific crypto asset. Always verify current market, team, tokenomics, and project facts before responding; never answer from memory.
